formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1/C4: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2); Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5) is listed after Parfum (4), so it is not a buffer under C4 -> no buffer -> strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: The betaine sits directly after the (early) fragrance marker; with it as a buffer C1 would give moderate. Convention keeps strong; confidence moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: No conditioning agent of any kind: no cationic, silicone, lipid, refatter or protein. Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (13) is a nonionic thickener.

weightPotential.rationale: No deposition family; unbuffered ether-sulfate reset.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with no prominent buffer (C1 strong).

excluded: Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil (11), Limonene (10) and other fragrance materials (14-16, 19-20): fragrance (6.4)
Glyoxal (22): cross-linking aid for the cellulose, trace
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: no deposition family exists.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: high-fragrance, unbuffered cleansing, no care routes - compatible with clarifying (cleansing not low, conditioning and weight not high, F6) if reset or oily-scalp positioning is revealed; otherwise general.

usageRole.rationale: Default; cleansing strong, so alternating fires only if reset intent (U4) is revealed.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA not met: no E4 route in positions 1-3. Counter-signals: strong cleansing, early Parfum, citrus peel oil.
